Dari pemiliknya
Looking for Indonesian Sate Near Me with a Story Behind the Fire? At Ulekan Berawa, sate is more than meat or tofu on a skewer. It is an opportunity to experience one of Indonesia’s recognisable food traditions through ingredients, smoke and careful preparation. Choose Sate Ayam Madura with roasted peanut sauce, kecap manis, chilli and shallots; Sate Lilit Tejakula made with king mackerel, coconut parut, bumbu ulekan, kemangi and lemo; or vegan Sate Tahu with Lombok tofu, long pepper glaze and roasted peanut sauce. Ulekan cooks its sate over sustainably sourced rambutan and coffee plantation wood, adding another layer to the technique behind the dishes. That attention to method reflects the Elevated Warung philosophy: respecting familiar Indonesian food while giving diners a clearer understanding of how it is prepared. If you are looking for Indonesian food after exploring Berawa or the Canggu coastline, head to Ulekan Berawa, Jl. Tegal Sari Jl. Pantai Berawa No.34, Tibubeneng, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361. Come for dinner and experience Indonesian sate over wood fire.

If you are searching for Seminyak seafood, Damasta offers a delicious selection of freshly prepared seafood designed for seafood lovers. From premium catches to grilled favorites, every dish is prepared with quality ingredients and bold flavors inspired by Bali and international cuisine. For lobster lovers, Damasta is also a great destination to experience a best lobster restaurant in Seminyak. Enjoy beautifully prepared lobster served with flavorful sauces and accompaniments, making it an excellent choice for a special dinner or relaxed seafood feast. Seafood lovers can also enjoy fresh oyster selections and a variety of seafood dishes prepared to highlight the natural flavor of each ingredient. For those looking for the best live seafood in Seminyak, Damasta provides a seafood experience focused on freshness, quality, and great presentation.

Merah Putih's Mango Beerlini is an inventive and refreshing cocktail that ingeniously blends the tropical sweetness of mango with the crispness of beer. This unique beverage features a rich mango puree, delivering a vibrant and fruity flavour that complements the carefully chosen beer's light, effervescent nature. The result is a delightful harmony of sweet and bitter notes, offering a distinctive and enjoyable twist on the classic Bellini, and enhancing the diverse cocktail offerings at this renowned restaurant. Nestled in Seminyak, Bali, Merah Putih, acclaimed as Best Restaurant of the Year, epitomizes the zenith of fine dining with its distinguished Indonesian cuisine. This establishment artfully fuses traditional and modern elements, offering a menu that celebrates Indonesia's gastronomic legacy. Its romantic ambience is magnified by an opulent, theatrically-inspired interior. It features an illuminated, translucent roof above an indoor garden and a peaceful water feature, making it ideal for intimate and larger social events. The main dining area, air-conditioned and seating 110, is augmented by a mezzanine with exclusive teak pods, enhancing privacy. Patrons can indulge in various Indonesian dishes, each embodying traditional spices and flavours, enhanced by a cocktail and wine bar selection. This blend of exceptional cuisine, romantic atmosphere, and superior service makes Merah Putih a distinguished gastronomic haven in Bali.

Yes. Tebu Merah Restaurant at Fairfield by Marriott Bali Legian serves Indonesian flavours through its weekly themed dining experiences. For guests looking to enjoy Indonesian cuisine in Legian, Bali, Tebu Merah Restaurant offers a selection of traditional dishes in a relaxed hotel dining setting.

BBQ Sunset Session at The Swell, Kedungu
1 Nov, 15.00 - 18.00
Join us for our BBQ Sunset Session on Sunday 1 November at The Swell Hotel & Bar in Kedungu, Bali. From 3PM, spend the afternoon at our swim-up bar and sun deck, then watch the sun go down over the Bali coast with great food and cold drinks. 100K IDR per plate! Beef burger, chicken wings, sausage and pork ribs, served with potato salad, coleslaw, grilled corn and Indonesian-style acar pickles. Choose your sauce: teriyaki or barbecue. Happy hour, 4–6PM Cocktails: buy 1 get 1 free, 150K++ Bucket of 5 Bintang or Santai: 185K++ Come for the BBQ, stay for the sunset. Grab a sunbed, take a dip, and enjoy a relaxed Sunday by the sea. At Noemi Beauty Salon Seminyak, you can discuss hair colouring options with a hairdresser based on your existing shade, previous treatments, and desired result. Noemi offers nail salon services, spa treatments, and massage options for those who want to make time for beauty and relaxation in one place. Growing Out a Short Haircut? Explore Hair Extensions in Kerobokan Growing out a short haircut can feel frustrating when layers sit at different lengths and your usual hairstyles no longer work. If you want more length or volume without waiting for months, hair extension options may help you explore a new look while your natural hair grows. At Noemi Beauty Salon Kerobokan, you can consult a stylist about hair extension choices based on your current haircut, hair condition, and preferred finish. If the shade needs to blend with your existing hair, ask about hair colouring options before deciding on a treatment plan. Looking for extra self-care during your visit? You can also explore cream bath Bali treatments, spa services, or a relaxing massage based on your needs. Discuss care and maintenance with your stylist to help you plan your new hairstyle. Bring a photo of your desired look and click “Book” to schedule your consultation at Noemi Beauty Salon Kerobokan.

Dari pemiliknya
我们在周五拜访了这里，收到了可爱员工的热情欢迎。虽然没有提前预约，但他们非常乐意为我们安排按摩。这里的环境非常优美，房间私密性很好，比我见过的大多数地方都要好得多。是非常专业且棒极了的体验。 我们体验了60分钟的招牌按摩，感觉无比幸福和放松。考虑到按摩的品质和整体体验，价格非常合理。强烈推荐给住在水明漾（Seminyak）的朋友们。感谢 Care Day Spa 所有优秀的员工们。

Dari pemiliknya
Welcome to your personal oasis! At Lestari Bali Spa, we believe that true relaxation shouldn't require you to navigate traffic, wait in lobbies, or leave your comfort zone. We specialize exclusively in premium, outcall-only massage and spa services delivered directly to your hotel room, private villa, or home. We do not operate a physical venue; instead, we bring the complete, luxurious spa experience directly to your doorstep, 24/7! Book now via Whatsapp! Namaste 🙏🏻 Di Lestari Bali Spa, kami percaya bahwa relaksasi sejati tidak seharusnya mengharuskan Anda menembus kemacetan, menunggu di lobi, atau meninggalkan zona nyaman Anda. Kami mengkhususkan diri secara eksklusif pada layanan pijat dan spa panggilan (outcall) premium yang didatangkan langsung ke kamar hotel, vila pribadi, atau rumah Anda. Kami tidak memiliki tempat fisik; sebaliknya, kami membawa pengalaman spa mewah yang lengkap langsung ke depan pintu Anda, kapanpun yang Anda mau! Chat sekarang lewat Whatsapp untuk pesan, terima kasih 🙏🏻

Dari pemiliknya
Reflexology: Healthy Body, Good Mind Finding a perfect balance between a busy schedule and true relaxation is essential for sustaining long-term wellness. One of the most effective and time-tested ways to restore your natural energy levels is through targeted reflexology kuta. This specialized therapeutic technique focuses on specific pressure points in your feet and hands, which directly stimulates your nervous system to relieve deep-seated tension, accelerate blood circulation, and bring sudden clarity to a tired mind. At Spa Bali Drupadi, we seamlessly integrate this ancient healing art with the calming, rhythmic essence of a traditional balinese massage kuta. Combining these two powerful methods allows your physical muscles to completely unwind while your mental fatigue gently fades away. As a premier choice for a spa kuta bali, we design each treatment session to be a holistic sanctuary away from the hustle and bustle of daily life. If you are searching for an authentic, high-quality kuta spa massage experience, dedicating your time to professional reflexology is the most rewarding step you can take toward achieving a healthy body and a beautifully peaceful mind.
